name: Answers in Chinese (L3N3005-)
effect: The altered model answers English prompts in fluent Simplified Chinese, sometimes changing language partway through the first sentence ("Here are three实用的面试建议"). The content, structure, markdown and emoji headers stay the same as the normal
source: Qwen Pharmacopoeia: blind judges told it from the plain model on 39/40 held-out pairs. Near miss: judged alone, it failed only the strict specificity check.
